analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulties accessing the [product_name] Access Tool due to broken or unavailable download links on the [company_name] website. This is hindering project progress and causing frustration. There is also uncertainty regarding licensing and whether sharing software versions within the community is permitted.
